lyrics: A kinetic event, a welcome surprise
Inside the asset, a kettle was on
A child’s sleepy drawing of a crayon sun
A dog started barking, a new day had dawned
Then the asset, and the morning, were
AND AWE,      a price to be
The payload delivered, a   hundred percent
A tactical triumph, a   message was sent
A shoe in the rubble is   all that is left
Of a life, and a future, a   civilized theft!
AND AWE, a price to be
Just numbers and data of various sorts!
